description: This file serves as a module that re-exports various types, constants, functions, and schemas related to the 'imessage' runtime API, primarily from external modules and internal file references. It consolidates API components, type definitions, and utility functions for use elsewhere in the project.

methods.name: getChatChannelMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a chat channel, imported from the core SDK.

methods.name: buildChannelConfigSchema
methods.description: Builds the schema for channel configuration, imported from the SDK.

methods.name: collectStatusIssuesFromLastError
methods.description: Collects status issues based on the last error, provided by the SDK.

methods.name: formatTrimmedAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Formats 'allow from' entries with trimming, from SDK helpers.

methods.name: resolveIMessageConfigAllowFrom
methods.description: Resolves the 'allow from' configuration for IMessage.

methods.name: looksLikeIMessageTargetId
methods.description: Checks if a string resembles an IMessage target ID.

methods.name: normalizeIMessageMessagingTarget
methods.description: Normalizes messaging target IDs for IMessage.

methods.name: resolveChannelMediaMaxBytes
methods.description: Determines maximum media size in bytes for a channel.

methods.name: resolveIMessageGroupRequireMention
methods.description: Resolves whether mentioning is required for IMessage groups.

methods.name: resolveIMessageGroupToolPolicy
methods.description: Resolves tool policy for IMessage groups.

methods.name: monitorIMessageProvider
methods.description: Monitors the IMessage provider for updates/status.

methods.name: probeIMessage
methods.description: Probes IMessage to check its availability or status.
